changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since the last digest (Thu 12, 2:20 PM)
items: The overall mix is about the same, but the east side got worse. Fishing right now is 6 GOOD / 0 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 5 VERY POOR (was 6 GOOD / 1 MARGINAL / 7 POOR / 2 VERY POOR). The same six grounds stay GOOD (Tara, Decabobo, Turda, Galoc, Maglalambay, Panlaitan). Cabunlawan, Ciron and Barangonan dropped back to VERY POOR (21–23 kt, gusts 27–30), and Coron slipped from MARGINAL to POOR on a 0.9 kt current.

Regional wind: Fri 13 13 kt, gusts 19 (was 12), Sat 14 11 kt (was 9.8), Sun 15 9.2 kt, Mon 16 11 kt, Tue 17 12 kt (was 11), Wed 18 5.0 kt (was 3.8), Thu 19 7.8 kt. Sat 14 and Sun 15 now show light rain (1.1 and 2.2 mm). Supply outlook is slightly softer through Sat 14, then recovers Sun–Mon; Wed 18 is still the best day. Shortage detector ELEVATED; surge OFF. PAGASA feed was unreachable again (SSL error); the CLEAR on the dashboard is only a default, not a confirmed check.

details: Today (13 kt, gusts 19) is the rough regional day , with arrivals soft Sat and slightly soft Sun. Relief arrives Sun 15 (9.2 kt, light rain); Mon 16 and Tue 17 rebuild to 11–12 kt, then Wed 18 is the best day (5.0 kt).
